cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(sh3_qt_tools_fixture LANGUAGES CXX)
enable_testing()
foreach(component LinguistTools UiTools UiPlugin)
  if(NOT EXISTS "${SH3_TOOLS_CMAKE_ROOT}/Qt6${component}/Qt6${component}Config.cmake")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Set SH3_TOOLS_CMAKE_ROOT to an explicit Qt Tools lib/cmake directory")
  endif()
  set(Qt6${component}_DIR "${SH3_TOOLS_CMAKE_ROOT}/Qt6${component}")
endforeach()
if(NOT EXISTS "${SH3_QT_CMAKE_ROOT}/Qt6/Qt6Config.cmake")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Set SH3_QT_CMAKE_ROOT to an explicit Qt Base lib/cmake directory")
endif()
foreach(component Core CoreTools Gui GuiTools Widgets WidgetsTools Test)
  if(NOT EXISTS "${SH3_QT_CMAKE_ROOT}/Qt6${component}/Qt6${component}Config.cmake")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing explicit Qt Base component: ${component}")
  endif()
  set(Qt6${component}_DIR "${SH3_QT_CMAKE_ROOT}/Qt6${component}")
endforeach()
find_package(Qt6 6.11.1 EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED COMPONENTS Core Gui Widgets Test LinguistTools UiTools
  PATHS "${SH3_QT_CMAKE_ROOT}/Qt6" NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(qm "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated/es.qm")
add_custom_command(OUTPUT "${qm}"
  COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E make_directory "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated"
  COMMAND Qt6::lrelease "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/es.ts" -qm "${qm}"
  DEPENDS es.ts VERBATIM)
add_custom_target(own_translation ALL DEPENDS "${qm}")
add_executable(qto_translation translation.cpp fixture.hpp)
target_link_libraries(qto_translation PRIVATE Qt6::Core)
add_dependencies(qto_translation own_translation)
add_executable(qto_ui ui.cpp fixture.hpp)
target_link_libraries(qto_ui PRIVATE Qt6::UiTools Qt6::Widgets)
foreach(target qto_translation qto_ui)
  target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
endforeach()
foreach(case translation recovery)
  add_test(NAME qto_${case} COMMAND qto_translation ${case} "${qm}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/invalid.qm.txt")
endforeach()
foreach(case ui invalid-ui)
  add_test(NAME qto_${case} COMMAND qto_ui ${case} "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/panel.ui" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/invalid.ui")
  set_tests_properties(qto_${case} PROPERTIES ENVIRONMENT "QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen")
endforeach()
foreach(case extract release invalid)
  add_test(NAME qto_${case} COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/check_tools.py" ${case}
    --lupdate "$<TARGET_FILE:Qt6::lupdate>" --lrelease "$<TARGET_FILE:Qt6::lrelease>"
    --source "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}" --work "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/tool-cases")
endforeach()
set_tests_properties(qto_translation qto_recovery qto_ui qto_invalid-ui qto_extract qto_release qto_invalid PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 60)
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/tools.json" CONTENT
  "{\"lupdate\":\"$<TARGET_FILE:Qt6::lupdate>\",\"lrelease\":\"$<TARGET_FILE:Qt6::lrelease>\"}\n")
if(SH3_QT_PROVIDER_SOURCE)
  # Copy before execution because upstream tests write QMs next to their TS inputs.
  file(COPY "${SH3_QT_PROVIDER_SOURCE}/tests/auto/linguist/lrelease/"
    DESTINATION "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/provider-source")
  set(CMAKE_AUTOMOC ON)
  add_executable(provider_lrelease "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/provider-source/tst_lrelease.cpp")
  target_link_libraries(provider_lrelease PRIVATE Qt6::Test)
  target_compile_options(provider_lrelease PRIVATE -UNDEBUG)
  # QLibraryInfo uses this explicit binary path without changing library loading.
  get_filename_component(base_prefix "${SH3_QT_CMAKE_ROOT}/../.." ABSOLUTE)
  file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/qt.conf" CONTENT
    "[Paths]\nPrefix=${base_prefix}\nBinaries=$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:Qt6::lrelease>\nPlugins=${base_prefix}/plugins\n")
  add_test(NAME provider_lrelease COMMAND provider_lrelease)
  set_tests_properties(provider_lrelease PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 90)
endif()
